title: Basil server configuration
description: Configuration for the Basil osu! server. Basil-specific settings are grouped under the Basil section alongside standard ASP.NET Core configuration such as AllowedHosts, Logging, and Kestrel.

AllowedHosts.description: Host patterns the server responds to. The default '*' accepts any host.

Basil.description: All Basil-specific settings, grouped by subsystem.

Server.description: Core server configuration: the host domain, the HTTPS listen port, and the TLS certificate.

Domain.description: The public domain clients use to reach the server. Must not be IP Address.

CertPath.description: Path to the HTTPS certificate (PFX). Leave unset to use the ASP.NET Core development certificate or another TLS termination mechanism.

CertPassword.description: The password that decrypts the HTTPS certificate.

Mirror.description: Optional beatmap mirror used for assets/downloads missing from local storage.

DownloadEndpoint.description: URL of the mirror serving .osz downloads for the /d/{set_id} endpoint. When set, beatmap downloads are proxied through this external mirror.

SearchEndpoint.description: URL of the mirror API serving osu!direct search results, independent of DownloadEndpoint.

Bot.description: Configuration for the built-in chat bot account that answers chat and !mp commands.

Name.description: The display name of the built-in chat bot account.

CommandPrefix.description: The prefix chat commands must start with, for example '!' for !help, !roll, and !mp.

Country.description: The two-letter country code of the built-in chat bot account.

Irc.description: Configuration for the embedded IRC gateway.

Name.description: The display name the IRC gateway announces for itself.

Port.description: The TCP port the IRC gateway listens on.

Logging.description: Logging settings for the host's Serilog configuration.
